text:
[Act: income-tax-2025
 Chapter: Offences and Prosecution
 Section: 481::Failure to comply with a direction of special audit or valuation.
]


If a person wilfully fails to comply with a direction issued to him under section 268(5), he shall be punishable with simple imprisonment for a term up to
six months, or with fine, or with both.]

metadata.section_title: Failure to comply with a direction of special audit or valuation.
